newsitem.title: USA: New Era of Networks amends IPO registration.
newsitem.headline: New Era of Networks amends IPO registration.

text.p: New Era of Networks Inc said it filed an amendment to its registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission regarding a proposed 2.3 million share initial public offering.
The offering price of the stock was expected to be between $10 and $12 per share, with UBS Securities and Cowen & Co as managing underwriters.
On January 22, New Era filed an initial public offering for 3.3 million shares.
All shares would be offered by the company and proceeds would be used to repay debt and for general corporate purposes, including working capital.
New Era develops, markets and supports application integration software and provides application integration services. The company was not immediately available for further comment.
